description: Finds the lines that match a regular expression in a file, or in all files under a folder. Returns file:line:text for each match.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Extended regular expression to search for, e.g. AGENT_NAME or def [a-z_]+

params.name: path
params.description: File or folder to search, relative to the tools folder; omit it to search the tools folder
